ignoreValues.reason: Heuristic false positives, all in this file: full-bleed sections get their horizontal inset from the child .container, and hairline-ruled lists give every row its own padding-block. Checked visually at 375/1024/1440. Trade-off: also hides any future genuine cramped-padding in index.html.
Intentional: body overflow-x:clip hides the off-screen honeypot input and the skip link parked above the viewport. Nothing visible is clipped.
Cream is the client's brand-board colour (supplied by the user), not a user-confirmed exception. Used on alternating sections only; black and gold carry the rest.

Deliberate, user-requested interaction: the header collapses to just the RT mark on scroll (one-time, on crossing the hero/content boundary — not a frequent or hover-driven transition). A transform-only version would either squash the wordmark's letterforms (scaleX) or leave a layout gap when the word fades but its box stays reserved. Confirmed smooth in-browser at 375/1440px.
